description: This file contains shell script code for testing Git hook functionalities, including setup procedures, push commands, output formatting, and comparisons to verify behavior.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with specified description and commands within the script.

methods.name: test_tool proc-receive
methods.description: Simulates or tests the 'proc-receive' hook behavior with verbosity and branch specification.

methods.name: make_user_friendly_and_stable_output
methods.description: Processes output to be user-friendly and stable for testing comparisons.

methods.name: format_and_save_expect
methods.description: Formats and saves expected output for comparison in tests.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares actual output to expected output in tests.

methods.name: test_cmp_refs
methods.description: Compares reference outputs of commits or refs in tests.
